Tests Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride(textLayoutMode) affects CSS text-size-adjust.
1. Mobile: false, textLayoutMode: "mobile"
PASSED: text-size-adjust is applied after navigation
2. Mobile: false, textLayoutMode: "default"
PASSED: text-size-adjust is restored to initial default after navigation
3. Mobile: true, textLayoutMode: "default"
PASSED: text-size-adjust is applied after navigation
4. Mobile: true, textLayoutMode: "mobile"
PASSED: text-size-adjust is applied after navigation
5. Defaulting when textLayoutMode is omitted
PASSED: mobile: false restores initial default after navigation
PASSED: mobile: true applies text-size-adjust after navigation
6. Clear device metrics override
PASSED: text-size-adjust is restored to initial default after navigation
